learning_outcomes.text: Apply obtained knowledge and skills in an independent and thorough development of engineering projects.
Gain practical skills and experience for future engineering practice or for continuing study in a Master degree course.

syllabus_topics: Review of the information regarding the diploma project topic
Analysis of output and work conditions
Idea project or methodology of research
Design of necessary equipment and devices
Technical and economic analysis of the developed variants
Development of technical documentation and graphical representation of the results from the research

assessment_methods.method: Public and moral qualities of the student (assessed by instructor)
Defense of the diploma project in front of the State Exam Committee

assessment_rules: The diploma project instructor assesses the level of involvement, and the public and moral qualities of the student. An assessor evaluates the diploma project. Students defend the diploma project in front of the State Exam Committee and the open public. The State Exam Committee evaluates both the diploma project and the way it is defended.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
